thread:
maya: Quick sync  planning the Sparkwave launch posts + webinar. Want to bundle: free starter credits (50), a prompt-template pack, and a 20-min 'Getting to First Useful Response' onboarding nudge. Also need a one-slide benchmark (latency + cost) for sales. Target: +20% <10-run activation week1. Thoughts?

alejandro: Love it. Two asks: 1) split-credit cohort vs no-credit for first 72h; 2) two headline directions (dev-first vs outcome-first). I can run A/B hooks. :rocket:

jun: For inbound routing  tag users who install the prompt pack within 24h as 'high-intent-webinar' and route to fast-lane segment. Can we add ?src to webinar CTA so we know post vs email?

maya: yes use ?src=sparkwave_post and ?src=welcome_email. jun you own the tag?

jun: yep. will add trait and webhook to CRM. SDR playbook: if usage >100 tokens and no team invite in 72h -> outreach.

sam: Webinar plan  30min: 10-min demo (prompt pack), 10-min benchmark story + Q&A. Proposed date: 2 weeks from launch. Drafted two short social copy variants below.

sam: (copy A - developer-first)
```
We built Sparkwave  low-latency inference for devs. Try 50 credits + prompt templates. Launch demo -> [link]?src=sparkwave_post :rocket:
```

sam: (copy B - outcome-first)
```
Ship features that save dev time. Get 50 starter credits + prompt packs. Live demo + benchmarks next Wed. Sign up -> [link]?src=sparkwave_post
```

olivia: I'll own metrics: activation (<10 runs), 7-day retention, cost-per-activated-user, webinar->demo->converted. Standardize event names: credit_redeemed, prompt_pack_installed, first_response_time.

maya: agreed. olivia make the dashboard by EOD Fri?

olivia: yes. will include cohort compare: credit vs no-credit, prompt-pack vs no-prompt-pack.

maya: Onboarding nudges (two lines): push1 immediate: "Welcome! Use your 50 credits  try 'Prompt Quickstart' to see results in <3 minutes." push2 24h: "Join our 20-min demo to see templates in action."

sam: I'll prepare banner + 3 tweet-length posts and a 60s benchmark clip for social.

alejandro: Experiment matrix: 1) credit (50 vs 0) 2) nudge timing (immediate vs 6h) 3) post headline (A vs B). Factorial first week; metric: <10-run activation.

maya: Owners: alejandro=experiment flags & post variants, jun=routing & playbook, sam=copy + webinar assets, olivia=dashboard & events. Prep freeze 48h before launch.

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar event created by sam for 'Sparkwave Launch Demo' on 3512350000. RSVP requested.

maya: Can engineering expose a deep-link to "import prompt pack" so the landing page can one-click preload templates? @eng-devex ping.

alejandro: If devex can support endpoint POST /v1/user/:id/import-template?src=sparkwave_post I'll add the deep-link. fallback = guided import flow.

jun: Document fallback in SDR playbook so leads don't slip.

maya: Checklist before EOD: asset list, experiment matrix, routing docs, dashboard skeleton, slide deck stub. I'll write a short runbook for launch-day comms. :white_check_mark:

sam: final copy & one-pager by tomorrow AM.

olivia: dashboard draft by Fri EOD.

alejandro: experiment flags & variants by Tue.

jun: routing + webhook + playbook by Tue.

maya: thanks team  will follow up with Loom summarizing this thread. :stars:
